Action 2: wait_for needs either a selector or ms.
Action 2: scroll needs to be "top", "bottom" or a pixel offset.
Action 2: unknown action "fly". Valid actions are goto, html, click, type, wait_for, scroll, screenshot, evaluate and extract.
